page.overview:
Who is The Guide?

The Guide was a mysterious individual who appeared to the Prisoner in dreams induced by the Spice Melange.

The Guide first called out to the Prisoner in a dream caused by exposure to the Spice Melange shortly after their arrival on Arrakis. He told them of the Trials of Aql, which they would need to complete to prove the knowledge of the ways of the Fremen.
